result.text: [{"dependency_responses":[{"action":"revise","reason":"依赖的锁存不等式在 v2 已明确『只判别雪崩、不判别 RPM』；本轮又确认该不等式划出的是 Preisach/雪崩边界，因此原分支的『设计边界』必须降级为可分辨性边界，并改为二维面（几何 × 刚度比），故按修订更新卡片。","ref":{"key":"latch_as_threshold_inequality","owner":"theory_scientist","version":2}}],"hypothesis_ref":{"key":"barrier_interaction_frontier","owner":"theory_scientist","version":2}},{"dependency_responses":[{"action":"revise","reason":"同一依赖变更要求把判据从『记忆/耦合与间隙的比较』改为『分散度与间隙的比较』并把后果限定为 scrambled/雪崩；peer 的刚度归一化又取消了『单旋钮锁死』，故更新为 v2 而非仅改链接。","ref":{"key":"latch_as_threshold_inequality","owner":"theory_scientist","version":2}}],"hypothesis_ref":{"key":"threshold_gap_addressability","owner":"theory_scientist","version":1}}]
